scripts.build:wasm:skip: echo 'Skipping WASM build - wasm-pack not available, using pre-built WASM files from pkg/'
scripts.build: sh -c '[ -f ../../.wasm-pack-env.sh ] && . ../../.wasm-pack-env.sh || true; command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1 && (pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts) || (pnpm run build:wasm:skip && pnpm run build:ts)'
